title: Sampling intensity and temporal persistence of airborne eDNA in partially enclosed spaces
description: Using airborne eDNA in a semi-controlled environment which acts as an artificial roost where species and their abundances are known, we estimate the sampling intensity (both the number of samples and number of sampling events) required to capture bat diversity of a given airspace and estimate the signal persistence of airborne eDNA, providing a temporal scale for airborne eDNA measurements.
